heroSummary:
St. Vrain Valley Schools uses a staggered start for 2027–28. Grades 1–5, 6, and 9 begin August 17; grades 7–8 and 10–12 begin August 18; kindergarten begins August 19; and preschool begins August 23. The last student day is May 25, 2028.

The calendar includes 174 student contact days and seven PLC late-start days. On PLC days, students attend school but start 2.5 hours later than usual.

whatsNew.title: What's Different From 2026–27
content: The earliest listed student start is one calendar day earlier, moving from August 18 in 2026 to August 17 in 2027.
Thanksgiving Break moves from November 23–27 in 2026 to November 22–26 in 2027.
Winter Break moves from December 21–January 1 to December 20–31; students return January 4 after a January 3 non-student contact day.
Spring Break moves from March 15–19 in 2027 to March 20–24 in 2028.
The last student day falls two days earlier in May, moving from May 27 in 2027 to May 25 in 2028.

calendarFaqs.a: SVVSD uses different start dates by grade. Grades 1–5, 6, and 9 begin August 17; grades 7–8 and 10–12 begin August 18; kindergarten begins August 19; and preschool begins August 23.

calendarFaqs.q: When do SVVSD students return after Thanksgiving Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break runs November 22–26, 2027. Students return Monday, November 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When do SVVSD students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: January 3, 2028, is a non-student contact day. Students return Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SVVSD Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 20–24, 2028. Students return Monday, March 27.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens on an SVVSD PLC late-start day?
calendarFaqs.a: Students attend school, but classes begin 2.5 hours later than usual. Check with your child’s school for exact bell times and transportation information.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for SVVSD in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 25, 2028. Graduation dates vary by school and program.

sourceReviewDetails: We checked the start dates by grade, 174 student contact days, seven PLC late-start dates, school breaks, return dates, and the last student day against the official English calendar.
Return dates are derived from the next scheduled student attendance day shown on the official calendar.

PLC dates are attendance days with a 2.5-hour late start. Confirm exact bell times and transportation information with your child’s school; its calendar may also list conferences, testing, and emergency changes.
The district also publishes a Spanish version of the 2027–28 academic calendar.
